articles.title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
articles.description:
Outgunned and outmanned, Boston still found a way to beat the Dodgers decisively on Friday night.

The post If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Red Sox defeated the Dodgers decisively on Friday night, showcasing their postseason potential.
This victory adds to Boston's strong performance in July, boosting team morale.
Residents can expect increased excitement and support for the Red Sox as playoffs approach.

articles.title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
articles.description:
Ceddanne Rafaela hit a two-run, go-ahead home run in the seventh inning.

The post Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Red Sox defeated Dodgers 9-4 in the series opener on August 1.
Ceddanne Rafaela hit a pivotal two-run home run in the seventh inning.
This victory boosts Red Sox playoff hopes, energizing local fans and the community.
